long_biography.plain_text:
France entered the family enterprise young, working alongside sister Lesa France Kennedy in varied jobs before assuming NASCAR leadership in 2003. He followed his grandfather, founder Bill France Sr., and his father, Bill Jr., as the third generation to direct the stock-car racing organization. His 15-year chairmanship included new playoff and team-charter formats, major broadcast agreements, and expanded safety and diversity programmes.

France stepped away from NASCAR in 2018. The following year he founded Silver Falcon Capital, shifting his day-to-day work from sports governance to direct investment. The firm partners with growth-oriented businesses and lists him as founder and brand visionary. He has also supported the NASCAR Foundation and family foundations whose grants focus on children's health, education, veterans and medical research.
